title: Research method for Age-related macular degeneration predicted effector genes (Orozco et al., 2020)
bodyHtml:
These results are from the study:

Integration of eQTL and a Single-Cell Atlas in the Human Eye Identifies Causal Genes for Age-Related Macular Degeneration.
Orozco LD, et al.
Cell Rep. 2020 Jan 28;30(4):1246-1259.e6. doi: 10.1016/j.celrep.2019.12.082.
PMID: 31995762

The authors generated an eye eQTL database by performing bulk RNA-seq on human retinal pigment epithelium (RPE)/choroid and retina tissues of both macular and non-macular regions from 129 human donor eyes and genotyping of SNPs on 121 donor eyes.

At each of 35 loci that were significantly associated with AMD risk in two previous GWAS (Fritsche et al. 2016, Persad et al. 2017), they performed co-localization of eQTLs and GWAS SNPs using the COLOC method (Giambartolomei et al., 2014). All SNPs across each locus were tested for co-localization. COLOC probabilities range from 0 to 1, with results closer to 1 indicating a higher probability that the same variant is causal for the GWAS signal and for the association with gene expression levels.
